column1: # C56, round 2 (2026-10-14): what moves a 2x PDFKit ink share when the bitmap does not.
# Every row is one PDF rendered through PDFKit as Tools/ux-harness.swift's `render` does (cropBox, white fill,
# the page's point size times `scale`); ink = pixels with luminance < 128. `Xin Qu_2018` p1 throughout.
# bitmap: `source mask` is the page's own JBIG2 /Mask (1400x2398, 227,821 ink px) re-encoded losslessly with
# jbig2enc; `published` is the app's output bitmap at HEAD 05d9ed1 (1400x2399, 228,036 ink px).
# form: how the bitmap is drawn. `gray image` is the app's writer (/ColorSpace /DeviceGray, 1 bit); `stencil`
# is /ImageMask with 0 g; `stencil lum20` fills at 0.0784 g, the source's JPX foreground colour; `masked JPX`
# is the source page itself, a JPX foreground drawn through the stencil. `+interp` adds /Interpolate true,
# `+decode` adds /Decode [0.0784 1]. `as published` is the app's file; `-text`, `direct`, `bbox±` are that
# file with the text layer removed, the image drawn in the page content instead of its form, and the form's
# page: the MediaBox and the image's rect, in points (the source's rect is offset 0.01999 pt).
